title: Common
description: Types shared by every message of protocol v1.

ProtocolVersion.title: ProtocolVersion
ProtocolVersion.description: Value of the `v` field of every envelope.

MessageId.title: MessageId
MessageId.description: Client-chosen identifier, unique per connection, echoed in `replyTo`.

EpochMillis.title: EpochMillis
EpochMillis.description: Server clock, milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

SessionToken.title: SessionToken
SessionToken.description: 128 cryptographically random bits, base64url without padding.

PlayerId.title: PlayerId
PlayerId.description: Opaque random identifier of a player (never a seat number).

RoomCode.title: RoomCode
RoomCode.description: 6 characters, without the ambiguous I, L, O, 0 and 1.

Nickname.title: Nickname
Nickname.description: Raw nickname. The server trims it and checks the rules (2 to 16 letters, digits, space, _ or -), answering NICKNAME_INVALID: only the size is bounded here.

CardId.title: CardId
CardId.description: Identifier of a card, randomly assigned for each match: it reveals nothing about the card.

Card.title: Card
Card.description: A card. Wild cards have no color of their own (`color: null`).

PenaltyStacking.title: PenaltyStacking
PenaltyStacking.description: official: SPEC §3. ladder: penalty cards pile up, +2 < +4 < +5, and a +4 cannot be challenged (ADR 0029).

DrawAmount.title: DrawAmount
DrawAmount.description: untilPlayable: a player with nothing to play draws until a card fits (ADR 0024); one: a single card (SPEC §3).

DrawRule.title: DrawRule
DrawRule.description: guided: no pointless draws, a plain drawn card is played automatically (ADR 0017); official: SPEC §3.

MatchLength.title: MatchLength
MatchLength.description: singleRound: one round decides the winner; to250 / to500: first player to reach the score.

CardMultiplier.title: CardMultiplier
CardMultiplier.description: How many times the host multiplies the copies of a special card of the deck (ADR 0028). Nothing else is accepted.

RoomSettings.title: RoomSettings
RoomSettings.description: House rules chosen by the host (see SPEC §4).

declareUnoToWin.description: House rule (ADR 0019): the last card cannot be played before UNO is announced.

drawTwoMultiplier.description: Draw Two in the deck: 8 x this (ADR 0028).

wildDrawFourMultiplier.description: Wild Draw Four in the deck: 4 x this (ADR 0028).

wildDrawFiveMultiplier.description: Wild Draw Five in the deck: 2 x this (ADR 0028).

RoomSettingsPatch.title: RoomSettingsPatch
RoomSettingsPatch.description: Partial settings: only the fields to change.

declareUnoToWin.description: House rule (ADR 0019): the last card cannot be played before UNO is announced.

drawTwoMultiplier.description: Draw Two in the deck: 8 x this (ADR 0028).

wildDrawFourMultiplier.description: Wild Draw Four in the deck: 4 x this (ADR 0028).

wildDrawFiveMultiplier.description: Wild Draw Five in the deck: 2 x this (ADR 0028).

ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode
ErrorCode.description: Every error the server can answer. MESSAGE_TOO_LARGE is reported as the WebSocket close reason (code 1009), not as an `error` message.

EmptyPayload.title: EmptyPayload
EmptyPayload.description: Payload of messages without parameters. tsType is a json-schema-to-typescript extension: an empty object type that rejects any property.
